meta.name: multimodal-orchestration
meta.description: Coordinating text, image, voice, and tool-use modalities in a single interaction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 协调文本、图像、语音和工具调用，实现多模态交互
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在一个交互中融合多种输入输出形式
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate text, image, voice, and tool-use in a single interaction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to blend multiple input/output modalities in one interaction

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会根据任务情境，智能选择最适合的模态（文本、图像、语音、代码等）来回应，并在不同模态间平滑切换，确保用户无需手动切换。
howto.when: 当用户请求涉及多种信息形式（如图像描述、语音转录、生成图表等）或需要Claude以多模态输出时触发。

say.text: 分析这张截图中的布局。
把我的语音笔记整理成要点。
帮我画一个流程图对比选项。

howto.what_en: Claude intelligently selects the most appropriate modality (text, image, voice, code, etc.) for each response, and smoothly transitions between modalities to avoid manual switching.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user request involves multiple modalities (e.g., image description, voice transcription, chart generation) or requires multimodal output.

say_en.text: Analyze the layout in this screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude responds with text describing the image.

say_en.text: Summarize my voice notes into bullet points.

say_en.note: Claude generates an image from description.
